title: PBS Could Lose 70 Years of Historic Archive Footage Over Cloud Dispute
summary: OSS reportedly had an agreement with information technology firm Iron Mountain to provide data storage, but went "defunct." As a result, the data was left stranded in one of Iron Mountain's data centers.
